slot: Global market data (with regional official sources)

pick.name: World Bank Open Data
pick.what: Free cross-country economic, demographic and internet-adoption indicators with APIs
pick.why: Broadest free primary-source coverage across countries; Claude can query the APIs directly.
pick.free_limits: Free; default CC BY 4.0 permits commercial use with attribution; some datasets carry other licences
pick.license: CC BY 4.0 by default (per-dataset labels vary)

best_free.name: Our World in Data
best_free.what: Curated charts and data on demographics, tech, economy, health
best_free.why: Easy cited charts and CSV/JSON API; OWID-produced data is CC BY.
best_free.free_limits: Free; CC BY for OWID data, third-party datasets keep their own licences

alts.name: MoSPI eSankhyiki MCP server (India)
alts.what: Official Indian statistics queryable by Claude via MCP
alts.why: Best India-specific source: official, free, MCP-native.
alts.free_limits: Free public beta (launched 6 Feb 2026); README lists 31 datasets
alts.maintained: repo active (103 commits; no release tags)
alts.install: claude mcp add --transport http esankhyiki-mcp https://mcp.mospi.gov.in/

alts.name: FRED (St. Louis Fed)
alts.what: US and international macro time series with an API
alts.free_limits: Free API; key and terms not confirmed on page

decision: Start with official cross-country statistics, then add the home market statistics office; let Claude query APIs instead of downloading PDFs. Pay for Statista-type data only for investor decks.

region_notes.US: FRED and US Census APIs are free.
region_notes.EU: Eurostat provides free official EU statistics.
region_notes.India: MoSPI eSankhyiki MCP (official, MCP-native); TRAI for telecom reach.

verify.note: Shallow check only: free/commercial terms are consistent with the cited licence; not re-opened in this pass.
